test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

She was __not allowed for going__ outside by her mother.
solution:
The correct answer is: **not allowed to go**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is "**not allowed to go**", which means that she was prohibited from leaving the house.
 
• The use of "**for going**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The verb "**allow**" is often followed by an infinitive (base form of the verb), which is** "to" plus the base form of the verb**.
 
• In this case, "**to go**" is the correct construction.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence**: *She was not allowed to go outside by her mother.*
